definition.commitsNoVerifiedShip: has building nights in the last 30 but zero shipped nights: commits seen, no deploy detected
definition.shipNightsWithoutCodeCommits: nights shipped by a deploy, release or contract deploy with no code commits that night (full 30-night windows only)
definition.shipNoPublicRepo: projects with shipped nights in the last 30 whose hasPublicRepo is false
definition.windows: only projects with >= 25 non-unavailable nights in the last 30 are counted; unavailable rows never count as coverage
